purpose: Prospective independent SQL-family controls for a streaming observable-order checker, not newly discovered bugs
notes: No tuning after viewing results. Empty keys require UNKNOWN. Each case has only exposed integer ORDER BY keys; no independent bag correctness claim.

cases.sql: SELECT id, id % 7 AS grp FROM range(0, 41, 1, 4) ORDER BY grp ASC, id DESC
SELECT k, v FROM VALUES (2,20),(1,10),(3,30) AS t(k,v) ORDER BY k DESC
SELECT k, v FROM VALUES (CAST(NULL AS INT), 0),(2,3),(1,4) AS t(k,v) ORDER BY k ASC NULLS FIRST, v DESC
SELECT k, v FROM VALUES (CAST(NULL AS INT), 0),(2,3),(1,4) AS t(k,v) ORDER BY k DESC NULLS LAST, v ASC
SELECT k, v FROM VALUES (1,3),(1,2),(2,5),(1,4) AS t(k,v) ORDER BY k ASC
SELECT k, v FROM VALUES (1,9),(3,7),(2,8),(4,6) AS t(k,v) ORDER BY k DESC LIMIT 3 OFFSET 1
SELECT k, v FROM (SELECT 3 AS k, 9 AS v UNION ALL SELECT 1,8 UNION ALL SELECT 2,7) AS t ORDER BY k ASC,v DESC
SELECT k, count(*) AS n FROM VALUES (2),(1),(2),(3),(1),(2) AS t(k) GROUP BY k ORDER BY n DESC,k ASC
SELECT l.id, r.v FROM VALUES (3,1),(1,1),(2,2) AS l(id,k) INNER JOIN VALUES (1,5),(1,2),(2,3) AS r(k,v) ON l.k = r.k ORDER BY l.id ASC,r.v DESC
SELECT l.id, r.v FROM VALUES (3,1),(1,2),(2,3) AS l(id,k) LEFT JOIN VALUES (1,5),(1,2),(2,3) AS r(k,v) ON l.k = r.k ORDER BY l.id ASC,r.v ASC NULLS LAST
SELECT l.id, r.v FROM VALUES (3,1),(1,2) AS l(id,k) RIGHT JOIN VALUES (1,5),(1,2),(2,3),(4,7) AS r(k,v) ON l.k = r.k ORDER BY l.id ASC NULLS LAST,r.v DESC
SELECT l.id, r.v FROM VALUES (3,1),(1,2) AS l(id,k) FULL OUTER JOIN VALUES (1,5),(4,7),(2,3) AS r(k,v) ON l.k = r.k ORDER BY l.id ASC NULLS LAST,r.v ASC NULLS LAST
SELECT k, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY k ORDER BY v) AS rn FROM VALUES (2,5),(1,8),(2,1),(1,3),(1,9) AS t(k,v) ORDER BY k DESC,rn ASC
SELECT DISTINCT k FROM VALUES (2),(1),(2),(4),(1) AS t(k) ORDER BY k DESC
SELECT k,v FROM (SELECT k,v FROM VALUES (4,1),(1,8),(3,2),(2,9) AS t(k,v) WHERE k > 1) AS u ORDER BY v DESC,k ASC
SELECT id FROM range(0, 20, 1, 4) ORDER BY id % 3, id
SELECT id FROM range(0, 20, 1, 4) SORT BY id DESC

calibration.sql: WITH top AS (SELECT id, CAST(id % 1 AS INT) AS k FROM range(0,3,1,2) ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT 1 OFFSET 1), b AS (SELECT id AS bid, CAST(id % 1 AS INT) AS k FROM range(0,2,1,2)) SELECT top.id,top.k,b.bid FROM top LEFT JOIN b USING(k) ORDER BY top.id ASC,b.bid ASC
